## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      4 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 8 abr 2026 - 20 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Bluesdude55_, 20 ago 2026, 1/5: "Poor and getting worse on Android...Sign in / Login issues everytime. Wasting too much time before being able to open app & start activity. No default setting retention. Auto Pause & type of activity setting should be set/forget similar to the Audio stat choice that remain checked or enabled. Actively looking for new app that works on the first launch. Purchase Information incorrect shows that I have over 400 days left on my subscription but using Free App Go version. don't recommend."
            2. _Mikołaj Ściobłowski_, 8 abr 2026, 1/5: "Laughably bad programming. The voiceover will spam you with useless info instead of playing interval audio cues, a bug that was present FIVE YEARS ago. [08/04/26] The most poorly coded running app managed to get even worse, it doesn't even launch now, congrats asics."
            3. _Sally_, 10 ago 2026, 3/5: "Great app, however lately it seems to be struggling capturing my runs from Garmin, I've uninstalled and reinstalled but still having issues refreshing. any suggestions to try and fix this are welcome."
